approval_scope: A digest representation and idempotency binding supplement only; not runtime grant/issuer acceptance, provenance/fingerprint algorithm approval or SQL promotion
algorithm: lowercase SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 JCS; closed ASCII property names; safe integer numbers; preserve Unicode/case/whitespace and array order; reject invalid UTF-8/unpaired surrogates

actor.issuer: 1..2048 UTF-8 bytes, non-whitespace; independently authenticated stable logical issuer ID
actor.subject: 1..256 UTF-8 bytes, non-whitespace; independently authenticated stable principal ID, not display name/shared role
rules: Issuer and subject are exact trusted identities; no lowercasing, URI rewriting, trimming or Unicode normalization in this profile.
Authentication must map rotated keys/certificates to the same stable logical issuer/principal; raw rotating key identities must not reopen actor scope.
A digest is a locator, not authentication or permission. Never accept client-supplied issuer/subject/digest as proof.

The v1 actor derivation is fixed for installation-lifetime idempotency records. A future identity/profile migration must preserve old scopes and keys; silent rehashing into a fresh actor namespace is forbidden.

grant.issuer: same stable logical issuer ID rule as actor, authenticated from reviewed grant profile
grant.grant_id: 1..128 ASCII characters matching ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,127}$, stable issuer-assigned logical grant identity
grant.version: separate immutable reviewed grant-version identity, included in request hash, not grant identity hash
rules: A logical grant identity plus version must identify one immutable fully authenticated grant, including purpose/target/actor/key/validity constraints.
Changing grant content/validity requires a new version; same identity/version with different bytes is unavailable. This supplement does not define or approve a grant signature/wire profile.

request.target_server_uuid: lowercase canonical 36-character UUID from trusted target identity; no case normalization of an untrusted claim
request.digests: all *_sha256 fields exactly 64 lowercase hex characters, derived/verified independently before write
request.reason: exact nonempty, non-whitespace approved/redacted reason, <=512 UTF-8 bytes; no trim/normalization for hashing
request.unknown_or_missing_fields: reject; transport/proof/context are separate arguments, never silently ignored request members
excluded: idempotency key (bound separately by authorization and unique scope)

rules: Grant renewal/key or session rotation cannot create a new actor/key scope.
Same scope/key with different request hash, including changed grant identity/version, conflicts; no write or nonce/key reopening.

Replay/unknown-commit observation retains original immutable request facts/hash and requires independent current observation authorization; authentication refresh must not rewrite saved request identity.
No observation grant or result-read wire profile is approved by this digest supplement.
A mere digest, read receipt or SQL row does not confer write authority.
Receipt schema_version v1 must select this exact v1 digest profile. Future profile changes require explicit version/migration handling and cannot reinterpret existing hashes.

required_before_promotion: runtime grant and observation authorization profiles
full source provenance and row fingerprint profiles
D ownership/schema-only inventory/catalog and migration review
audit anchor retention/capacity and GC compatibility
